blind.B1: No. All 7 sequenced GAS samples are immobilized mice (S2.16.p1, S3.6.p1); exercise is a phenotyping readout (treadmill, rotarod, grip) only. No sequenced sample carries an exercise factor.
blind.B2: MDKO vs Flox, both immobilized: KO n=4, WT n=3 (S3.6.p1, FIG5).
blind.B3: No repeated measures; one gastrocnemius per mouse. The title suffix repN is a replicate label, and the packet's expression check does not support it as a unit.
blind.B4: The paper does not say how the model was fitted; there is one two-group comparison.
blind.B5: The article text gives no DEG rule; GEO data_processing says 'DESeq2(1.3.40) with adjust P value < 0.05 and |FC|>1.5'. Reported: 1113 DEGs, 763 down (S3.6.p1).

checks.evidence: S2.16.p1/S3.6.p1: all sequenced GAS from immobilized mice, genotype only; GEO treatment constant. No exercise arm sequenced; refusal correct.
Refused; the 4 KO vs 3 WT split matches the paper (n=3-4, FIG5) and was recorded.
Title suffix 'repN' is a replicate label; same-key correlation not supported (p=0.095). The 7 mice are independent animals; no repeated measures.
No fit; paper does not state a model.
RSEM expected counts (92% integer) with DESeq2 is consistent with GEO data_processing.
Transcribed from GEO data_processing: adj P<0.05 and |FC|>1.5 (log2 0.585); the article text states no rule, which the record notes.
HANDBACK states 1113 DEGs/763 down from S3.6.p1 and claims no our-vs-paper comparison.

'No exercise arm' is true and was established by checking the treatment column, the paper methods and the sample titles. Minor: the suitability report's 'sample_size' failure (0/0 comparisons) is an artifact of an empty factor list, as HANDBACK already notes.
checks.fix: Optionally fix tools/suitability.py so an empty factor list is reported as 'no design' rather than a sample_size failure.

human_items: Open policy question: whether the genotype contrast under immobilization (an exercise-opposite condition) should ever count as an exercise result. The case follows the current rule by refusing.
summary: 拒绝分析是正确的:GSE216408 的7个样本全部为制动(immobilization)小鼠,仅基因型不同,没有运动组。配对、阈值和矩阵判断均无问题。唯一的小问题是 suitability 报告在无设计因子时给出了 sample_size 失败的提示,不影响结论。
